If the channel is busy, it has to perform the backoff procedure using the first time zero cw mean, then doubling the convolution window, etc. Etc. Right? All of them follow the same rules. So this means that if we look at the average behavior, when we consider BCF, we have that on average, on average, the nodes will access the channel the same number of times. And each time they will transmit one packet, right? So they will have the chance to transmit the same number of packets. So if we make some simplifying assumptions, let's consider that we have here the access point, and then two stations A and B that are connected to the access point. And let's consider that both A and B have a max queue that is full of packets. Okay, assume that there are always packets coming in. So they always have.
